name: Critical Effects (BC): Rending - Arm
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-19 (p. 254). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: The target drops anything held in that arm.
The target drops whatever was held and takes 1 level of Fatigue.
The target drops whatever was held. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or suffer Blood Loss.
Knocked Prone and 2 levels of Fatigue. The limb is useless for [[1d10]] rounds.
Blood Loss. The target drops anything held and the limb is useless without medical attention.
[[1d5]] fingers severed; on a 5 it is the thumb. Stunned for 1 round. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or lose the use of the hand.
[[1d10]] Strength Damage and Blood Loss. Arm broken: counts as having one arm until repaired.
Arm severed. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and Blood Loss.
The target dies. If he carried a ranged weapon, there is a 5% chance the severed hand fires it: resolve a single hit from that weapon against a random target within [[2d10]] metres.
